title: Newsweek Names Bloom Energy to World’s Most Trustworthy Companies List in 2026
summary: Bloom Energy, a global leader in power solutions, today announced it has been named to Newsweek’s World’s Most Trustworthy Companies 2026 list, ranking no. 21 in the Energy & Utilities category. The list, developed with Statista, recognizes 1,000 companies across 20 countries.
body_markdown:
- Bloom recognized as a trusted global leader among customers, investors, and employees
- Ranking reflects 25 years of delivering reliable onsite power for businesses and communities worldwide


**SAN JOSE, Calif., September 10, 2026** — Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE), a global leader in power solutions, today announced it has been named to Newsweek’s World’s Most Trustworthy Companies 2026 list, in the Energy & Utilities category. The list, developed with Statista, recognizes 1,000 companies across 20 countries.


“Organizations and communities around the world rely on Bloom to power their most critical operations,” said Natalie Sunderland, CMO of Bloom Energy. “For 25 years, we’ve helped hospitals, colleges, manufacturers, retailers and data centers access clean, reliable power when and where they need it. We’re honored to be recognized for the confidence our customers, employees and investors place in us.”


Newsweek’s World’s Most Trustworthy Companies 2026 ranking, developed in partnership with Statista, recognizes 1,000 companies across 20 countries that have demonstrated trust among customers, investors and employees. The ranking is based on an independent survey of more than 65,000 participants who submitted approximately 200,000 company evaluations across three dimensions of trust, as well as a social listening analysis of more than 500,000 company mentions.


The World’s Most Trustworthy Companies 2026 list can be viewed on Newsweek’s website.


**About Bloom Energy** Bloom Energy empowers enterprises to meet soaring energy demands and responsibly take charge of their power needs. The company’s fuel cell systems provide ultra-reliable, clean and highly scalable onsite electricity for Fortune 500 customers around the world, including data centers, semiconductor manufacturing, large utilities and other commercial and industrial sectors, as well as mission-critical organizations in local communities, such as hospitals, college campuses and retailers. Headquartered in Silicon Valley, Bloom Energy employs more than 2,000 people worldwide and manufactures its systems in the United States. For more information, visit BloomEnergy.com.
